violated_contract: Hermetic Dart tests and journeys must not encode the host's calendar day or timezone. A UTC timestamp compared against DateTime.now(), or grouped with `.single` as "the same day", is only true in the author's zone and on the author's date; hosted CI and UTC+ hosts fail with StateError('No valid conversation found') or a missed day-bucket.
canonical_prevention: Construct same-day fixtures with local DateTime(y, m, d, h) (app/test/support/local_day.dart) or conversationLocalDayKey of the record; pin ConversationDetailProvider.selectedDate to that key; default "today" through package:clock so tests can freeze time. Prove the suite under TZ=Pacific/Kiritimati and TZ=Pacific/Pago_Pago via bash app/test.sh and make mobile-verify ARGS="fast --all".
